# Pakistan Bill Calculator

> Independent, free estimator for electricity, gas and water bills in Pakistan. NOT an official company website. Results are estimates only.

## How to use
- Choose a company page, enter units (kWh for electricity, HM3 for gas), choose category and protected status where applicable, and press Calculate.
- All rates live in /data/tariffs.json. Rates marked VERIFY_RATE are NOT yet confirmed from an official source, and the calculator deliberately shows no total for those companies until the rates are filled in.
- A custom-rate mode lets a user estimate from a rate on their own bill, clearly labelled as user-entered, not official.

## Companies covered
- Electricity: LESCO, FESCO, GEPCO, IESCO, MEPCO, PESCO, HESCO, SEPCO, QESCO, TESCO, K-Electric, Solar Net Metering
- Gas: SNGPL, SSGC
- Water: WASA Lahore, KWSC Karachi
- Cities: Lahore, Faisalabad, Gujranwala, Sialkot, Islamabad, Rawalpindi, Multan, Peshawar, Hyderabad, Sukkur, Quetta, Karachi, Bahawalpur (each with its own calculator page)
- Blog: 22 guides on electricity bill, gas bill, water bill, slabs, FPA, GST, HM3, solar and duplicate bills
- Search: /search/ — search by city or company
- Phase 2: PTCL / internet calculators (planned, not yet built)
